Copilot users in JetBrains IDEs also get context usage shortcuts, historical diffs, simpler… The post GitHub Copilot in JetBrains, Ignite releases appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: This update brings remote access, on-device voice dictation, and browser use controls to GitHub Copilot for JetBrains. Copilot users in JetBrains IDEs also get context usage shortcuts, historical diffs, simpler follow-up controls, and improvements to chat reliability.
takeaways: User experience enhancements You can manage conversations and find model options with fewer steps: Conversation timing : See timestamps on Copilot agent prompts and responses.
Model picker : Find Copilot Fusion pinned at the top of Copilot agent model management, where it stays enabled even when you deselect the entire model group.

You also get clearer error messages for failed tool calls, working historical session diffs on newer JetBrains IDE EAP builds, and improvements to context search, code formatting, input focus, and MCP sign-in recovery.
